Welcome to IIITDM Jabalpur Placement Discussion! 👋

This group is for discussing every company's OA at IIITDM Jabalpur: the ones that have already happened here and the ones coming up. Share OA dates, test formats, shortlists and interview experiences so everyone from IIITDM Jabalpur can prepare together.

Please don't share answers while a test is still live.
